modern: In the constitution of the rational being I see no virtue which is opposed to justice; but I see a virtue which is opposed to love of pleasure, and that is self-control.
original: In the constitution of the rational animal I see no virtue which is opposed to justice; but I see a virtue which is opposed to love of pleasure, and that is temperance.
